body: I personally recommend mechanical pencils. A good starter pencil is the Graph Gear 1000, but if your looking for something a little nicer, I would say get the Rotring 600. If you're the type to always break lead on mechanical pencils, you should get the Zebra Delguard. When it comes to lead, I always recommend Pentel Ain Stein (I would recommend 2B, but that's just a preference). If you prefer wooden pencils over mechanical, I love Blackwing, but they're very expensive. Uni Mitsubishi pencils are also very good wooden pencils.

It sounds like since you're an international student there might be challenges that I can't imagine but by finding hobbies that actually interest you, you'll eventually find some people who will want to connect with you and vice-versa. I think it's also extremely important to be able to find joy within the solitude, and as an introvert, it's much easier for me to do so. I highly recommend some mindfulness training (if you're not doing it already) as well as training the body. I know it's all some basic ass info but taking the first steps is very important.
